answer: A beacon fires a random pulse every 300 seconds; each identity must mirror it in a reply the contract voids beyond 2 seconds, earning one credit decaying 15% per epoch. Attestation needs 20 credits, so a sybil with k identities must keep k sub-2-second channels hot: cost is linear in n, and pulse randomness plus decay kill pre-farmed resets. Rules sit like marble in the beacon contract: late replies are void, missing 3 of 10 pulses means 5-epoch quarantine, decayed credits fund auditors. An attacker rents one low-latency link per fake identity, n times honest cost.
